item: row 321: backup preflight and diagnostics count the write-ahead log
key_paths: src/backup/artifact.py; src/paths.py; src/api/diagnostics/bundle.py; src/api/diagnostics/performance.py; src/monitoring/benchmark.py; tests/test_backup_preflight_wal_row321.py
summary: The H3 backup free-space preflight adds each store's -wal size (corpus and custody), read by stat only per R789, so a large pending log no longer lets a backup start and fail on a full disk; diagnostics bundle, performance report and benchmark gain a separate wal_bytes beside db_bytes (db_bytes unchanged). Real WAL stores on plaintext and SQLCipher pin the refusal on both legs.
